fullPassage: The act of improvisation, when it enters our thoughts, is generally contextualized within the realm of the arts. A group of jazz musicians gather without any sheet music and invent music that’s never been heard before, and actors venture onto stages or in front of cameras and perform scenes without a script, making up the dialogue and actions on the spot. In both cases, each set of performers finds artistic success ―they entertain their audiences through improvisation, by creating something new in the moment. However, this skill is not confined to artistic endeavors; it proves equally useful in negotiations, where, for negotiators, there is no script —only a stage. Negotiators can’t plan for all the possible directions a negotiation might take, nor can they predict the changing demands of the other party. Improvisation empowers them to think on their feet and thrive in fluctuating circumstances so that they can maintain a position of strength throughout the negotiation process. To improvise effectively, negotiators, like musicians and actors, must actively listen. The ability to listen is what allows a negotiator to identify the interests of the other party and respond appropriately to work toward a mutually beneficial resolution. Attentive listening also builds trust and encourages sincere participation from everyone involved. It shows the other party that the negotiator is willing to cooperate in helping them achieve their objectives rather than trying to just dominate the negotiation. Employing improvisation instead of a set pattern of reasoning further frees the mind to pursue divergent thinking, which can help negotiators come up with out-of-the-box solutions that otherwise would not be available.

② speak first(먼저 말하다) — 경청 강조 흐름과 반대
③ actively listen(적극적으로 경청하다) ✅ 정답 — 뒤 문장이 '경청'을 부연함
④ avoid eye contact(눈맞춤을 피하다) — 신뢰·참여를 강조하는 글과 모순

questions.passage: The act of improvisation, when it enters our thoughts, is generally contextualized within the realm of the arts. A group of jazz musicians gather without any sheet music and invent music that’s never been heard before, and actors venture onto stages or in front of cameras and perform scenes without a script, making up the dialogue and actions on the spot. In both cases, each set of performers finds artistic success ―they entertain their audiences through improvisation, by creating something new in the moment. However, this skill is not confined to artistic endeavors; it proves equally useful in negotiations, where, for negotiators, there is no script —only a stage. Negotiators can’t plan for all the possible directions a negotiation might take, nor can they predict the changing demands of the other party. Improvisation empowers them to think on their feet and thrive in fluctuating circumstances so that they can maintain a position of strength throughout the negotiation process. To improvise effectively, negotiators, like musicians and actors, must actively listen. The ability to listen is what allows a negotiator to identify the interests of the other party and respond appropriately to work toward a mutually beneficial resolution. Attentive listening also builds trust and encourages sincere participation from everyone involved. It shows the other party that the negotiator is willing to cooperate in helping them achieve their objectives rather than trying to just dominate the negotiation. Employing improvisation instead of a set pattern of reasoning further frees the mind to pursue divergent thinking, which can help negotiators come up with out-of-the-box solutions that otherwise would not be available.

det.korean: 주어(it) + 동사(proves) + 보어(equally useful) + 장소(in negotiations)
det.analysis:
'그것은'은 주어 it이에요. '유용함이 드러난다'는 'prove + 형용사(~인 것으로 드러나다)' 구문으로, 주어 it이 단수라 proves를 써요
'똑같이 유용한'은 부사 equally가 형용사 useful을 꾸며 equally useful이 돼요
'협상에서'는 in negotiations예요
순서대로 이으면 it proves equally useful in negotiations, 총 6단어예요
det.tip: prove + 형용사 = ~인 것으로 드러나다 (it proves equally useful)

'free + 목적어 + to부정사'로 '~을 자유롭게 하여 …하게 하다'를 나타내요. 주어가 'Employing improvisation ...(즉흥을 활용하는 것)'으로 단수라 동사에 -s를 붙여 frees로 시작해요
